title: User Request Frequency
scenario: Calculate the average number of confirmation requests per user. Return the result table as 'avg_requests'.
tableSchema: signups (user_id INT, time_stamp DATETIME), confirmations (user_id INT, time_stamp DATETIME, action VARCHAR)
hint: Count requests per user first, then take the average of those counts.
correctQuery: SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_requests FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM confirmations GROUP BY user_id) t;
